subject: general
question: In 2023, a three-day All-India Taekwondo Championship was organized in _________ to mark 50 years of Korea-India diplomatic relations.
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The All-India Taekwondo Championship was organized in **New Delhi** in 2023 to commemorate 50 years of Korea-India diplomatic relations.
 
• This event brought together participants from various states across India, showcasing the talent and sportsmanship in the field of Taekwondo.
 
• The championship aimed to strengthen the cultural and diplomatic ties between Korea and India through the medium of sports.
 
• New Delhi, being the capital city, was chosen as the host for this significant event to ensure maximum visibility and participation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Taekwondo** is a Korean martial art that has gained popularity worldwide, including in India.
 
• The **diplomatic relations** between Korea and India were established in 1973, and have since grown stronger through various cultural, economic, and sports exchanges.
 
• Such events not only promote sports but also foster international goodwill and understanding.
 
• New Delhi frequently hosts international sports events due to its infrastructure and facilities.
